question: Can the official MIT-Adobe FiveK individual-file interface provide a bounded 512-pair population, disjoint from all 255 prior rows, for a scale-sensitive explicit case-bank Oracle study?

scientific_role.hypothesis: Increasing the disjoint case-bank population from the prior 64-pair regime may make a source-only hard case selector useful, but only if an off-diagonal evaluator Oracle first beats the fixed global explicit operator on held-out photographs.
scientific_role.forbidden_inference: FiveK is not film, a film stock, real-film truth, stock calibration or product-rights evidence
scientific_role.next_gate_if_pass: bounded exact acquisition, integrity and leakage audit; operator fitting remains closed until those gates pass

official_source.rights_scope: internal non-commercial research only; preserve copyright and license with retained data; no redistribution, commercial-weight or product-rights decision

branch_rules.pass: open only the exact bounded acquisition, integrity/leakage audit and a preregistered off-diagonal explicit-operator Oracle; do not train a router first
branch_rules.fail: close this selection without mirror substitution, broad archive download, threshold relaxation or model-capacity rescue

claim_ceiling: metadata, rights and URL feasibility for one disjoint 512-pair FiveK digital-retouch control population; no pixels, learning, film, stock, calibration, preference or product claim
